entries.reopen_condition: never as a decode ceiling. The reuse band is a valid cache-resident roofline for a working set that actually stays hot. It is not a batch=1 decode bound.

entries.mechanism: Compress routed experts to move fs/weight or token time (the density campaign on the 9%)
entries.why_it_failed: Storage mass is not traffic. At batch=1 the unread 502 experts do not move. Crushing unused experts to zero removes 9% of per-token bytes. Attention is the only mass whose compression changes the token.
entries.reopen_condition: never as a token-time or fs/weight lever on Q80 batch=1 decode. Expert compression remains a disk/residency lever. Reopen as a velocity lever only if routing changes so that a much larger expert fraction is actually read per token (e.g. large-batch or many-token expert reuse that makes unread experts become traffic).

entries.mechanism: Assume lower storage BPW is faster per token (density is velocity)
entries.why_it_failed: Binary / rice_q1 / low-rank need expensive per-weight reconstruction. Density bought bytes and lost more to reconstruction. On the mixed G020 vehicle Q80 is GPU-matvec-bound, not host-bound. The Q4-vehicle 'host/sync-bound' claim does not transfer.
entries.reopen_condition: never as an unqualified 'lower BPW is faster' rule on mixed codecs. Reopen a density-for-speed claim only after reconstruction is in-register or fused into consumption (S004 section 7 items 5-6) and a same-vehicle GB/s is remeasured at or above the Q4 15.2 GB/s mark.

entries.why_it_failed: Alpha is already random. A free permutation does not move a reconstruction/occupancy wall.

entries.why_it_failed: New (layer, expert) pairs keep appearing. Each miss still pays catalog read + SHA-256 + MTLBuffer copy (90-245 ms on late tokens). Residency of yesterday's experts does not help today's misses.

entries.mechanism: Prefetch this token's experts from the previous token's route set

New (layer, expert) pairs are exactly the ones the previous token did not use. Cross-layer expert overlap is not assumed (Q80 experts mutually orthogonal — NS-010).
entries.why_it_failed: The predictor cannot see the misses that cost money.
entries.reopen_condition: never as a previous-token route predictor. A corpus-level hot-set prebind is a different mechanism.

entries.reopen_condition: never on this GPU without a grid-wide barrier or a layout that does not recompute R[160x512] per TG.

entries.mechanism: Run rice_q1 serial bitstream expand on the per-token path
entries.why_it_failed: 15.6 ms/organ serial. Bind-time expand + CSR apply is the token path.
entries.reopen_condition: never as a per-token kernel. Bind-time expand stays.

entries.mechanism: Blame 10-of-512 gather vs sequential access for the Q80 bandwidth gap

entries.mechanism: Compare a 0.59 MiB isolated Q80 organ to a 64 MiB DRAM-row probe and call it a 230x occupancy gap

entries.reopen_condition: never as a Q80 slogan. For Qwen3.8-sized (~50 MiB) organs, ~180 GB/s isolated is the right comparator, not 550-647.

entries.mechanism: Present an isolated-organ product (e.g. 192 ms = 48×10×(gate+up+down)) as a token time
entries.what_was_measured: q80-decode-kernels 192 ms is 480 isolated organ dispatches on deterministic_matrix, not a full token, not BF16 parent, not 0-fallback generate. Baking it next to the 403 ms incumbent is a unit error.

entries.what_was_measured: Single 11-token CPU-wall decode, no paired reps, no GPUEndTime-GPUStartTime, 1637 fallbacks. Ledger GPU median 175.04 ms, wall median 571.51 ms. Filename QWEN80_UNIFORM_Q4_VELOCITY_BASELINE.json is a separate trap (metal: no Metal-capable GPU).

entries.verdict: DEAD, and the row-norm rescue hypothesis is falsified.

entries.verdict: dead on arrival: there is no shared component to subtract

entries.verdict: LIVE AND CONVERGENT. Three independent lanes found the same thing without coordination.
entries.killed_by: nothing - this is a POSITIVE entry recording where the campaign found real headroom.

entries.verdict: NEARLY exhausted, NOT closed. CORRECTED from an earlier overclaim in this same campaign.
